title: AI is a monster, in it's truest form
author: xdchan
selftext:
The word *monster* can be traced to the words like *monstrare,* meaning "to reveal", "to show". *monere -* "to remind", *monstrum -* the concept that exists on far edges of the map, something just out of sight, a vague shape meshing the ideas.

It strips away the friction of the boilerplate, and now, instead of a decade of mastering the intricacies of a specific tool - it brings out the idea in it's pure form to life, it allows everyone to truly speak the inner workings of their mind into existence, to not be limited by deep mechanical skills and the cobweb of delicate tools. 

And if there is nothing to reveal, nothing to amplify... The result will be nothing as well. A stale mind mirrored and magnified is still just as empty, as well as bitter mind, revealing the hate and malice straight out.

It mirrors the collective too, the *monere*, "to remind", as a monster created from vast archives of human expression it has no ego to cling to, so the expression itself shows humanity in it's raw form, all our biases and rages, as well as softest sides, interconnectedness, the shared visions,  and distant ones as well. 

There is something beautiful in the ability to speak your mind into existence, to reveal the colors of your inner world through the language itself. 

It is a monster revealing nature of the ones who use it's power.
